title.narrative: Sudan (the): Fragility, Emergencies, and Displaced populations

description.narrative: Flexible and tailored support through bespoke and differentiated interventions in countries facing chronic fragility; agile and coordinated response in acute emergencies; and a laser focus on displaced populations in Gavi-eligible countries. This is facilitated through differentiated interventions, particularly subnational and community-based, to respond to the challenges in each setting. A coordinated approach, through the humanitarian development peace nexus, that brings together different actors, leveraging their comparative advantage, is a key enabler to any progress. Innovations suited for the specific challenges faced in settings affected by fragility and emergencies, including in grant management also play a strong role.

This activity details our work on Fragility, Emergencies, and Displaced populations in Sudan (the) through the provision of budget and transaction data. We also provide the relevant documents that guide these activities, which are the support request proposal(s) provided by the Government of Sudan (the), as well as the decision letter(s) issued by Gavi, for progress. These documents describe the activities, the objectives as well as the beneficiaries.
